notes.title: MANIC v1.3.0 now available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Hope you're doing well and are staying safe.

There's a new update available for MANIC, both on Windows and OSX.

The update includes a brand new wave-based "arena mode," that allows for the endless slaughtering of enemies! Alongside this, there have been numerous bug fixes, tweaks and polishes to make the campaign more refined and enjoyable.

It is the last (major) update for the game before the mobile port enters development, scheduled for release by the end of the year!

Please enjoy, and thank you for your support!

One more thing: Over the past few months, Geta have been working on our second major project. Stay tuned for more information on that early 2021!
